title: Android 9.0 Pie (ZTE Axon 9 Pro) blocking wakeups from Doze
body:
My ZTE Axon 9 Pro updated to Pie a few days ago, causing XDrip to start failing - specifically whenever phone is on battery and screen is off (that is dozed), XDrip doesn't receive any data, with screen on or on connected power, it works perfectly.

Being a developer (with very limited Java experience though) I tried to debug the situation:
- Disabled "Adaptive Battery" feature, verified that Xdrip is not optimized automatically and is "allowed to run in background, even if it drains battery fast". No change, XDrip is still not being waken up
- found that there is already a workaround in place for buggy Samsung phones, using `setAlarmClock` call instead of `setExactAndAllowWhileIdle`, so I hard enabled it, deployed, but still no changes, no waking up... (although there is now a clock icon visible in notification line...)

So my question is, is there anything more that I can do/try to debug?
Any other Android setting that I've missed and could be relevant?
Any other possible workaround?

Thanks, Blaž
